input.query: SELECT doc_type, platform, MIN(decision_date) AS min_date, MAX(decision_date) AS max_date FROM agg_kyc_daily WHERE platform ILIKE '%ios%' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT platform, version, release_date FROM stg_app_releases WHERE platform ILIKE '%ios%' AND release_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-03-15' AND DATE '2026-05-01' ORDER BY release_date

SELECT doc_type, platform, SUM(n_decisions) AS decisions, SUM(n_approved) AS approved, SUM(n_approved)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_decisions) AS approval_rate FROM agg_kyc_daily WHERE platform ILIKE '%ios%' AND decision_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-06' AND DATE '2026-04-26' GROUP BY 1,2
